classification.difficultyReason: Read side lengths from the grid, recognise that C must be compared after rotation, and justify similarity through matching side ratios and right angles. The orientation change adds a routine correspondence decision.

content.prompt: Here are two rectangles, A and B, drawn on a square grid.

spec.description: A and B share a 21-column, 6-row square grid. Both top edges are one row below the top. Labelled rectangle outlines require free-form TikZ rather than the blank-grid template. Decorative green fills are omitted under house style.
spec.mathematics: A occupies columns 2–6 and rows 3–5, measuring 4 by 2 cells. B occupies columns 11–19 and rows 1–5, measuring 8 by 4 cells. Each cell is 4 mm square, matching the C grid.
spec.answerVisibility: All grid lines, rectangle outlines and labels are permanent student-visible givens; no calculated dimensions or answers are printed.

children.label: a
children.prompt: Explain why rectangle B is similar to rectangle A.

answer.short: All corresponding angles are $90^\circ$, and each corresponding side has been doubled.
answer.worked: A is $4\times2$ grid cells and B is $8\times4$ grid cells. The corresponding side ratios are $\frac{8}{4}=2$ and $\frac{4}{2}=2$. All corresponding angles are $90^\circ$, so the rectangles are similar.

children.label: b
children.prompt:
Here is a third rectangle, C.

Is rectangle C similar to rectangle A? Explain your answer.

spec.description: Upright rectangle C is shown to the right of its prompt on a 6-column, 10-row square grid. The labelled rectangle outline requires free-form TikZ rather than the blank-grid template. Decorative green fill is omitted under house style.
spec.mathematics: C is 4 cells wide and 8 cells high, with a one-cell margin on every side. Each cell is 4 mm square, matching the shared A/B grid.
spec.answerVisibility: The upright outline, grid and C label are permanent givens. Rotation and similarity conclusions appear only in answers.

answer.short: Yes. C is B rotated through $90^\circ$, so it is similar to A.
answer.worked: C has side lengths of $8$ and $4$ grid cells. After rotation, its corresponding sides match those of B. Compared with A, $\frac{8}{4}=2$ and $\frac{4}{2}=2$, and all corresponding angles are $90^\circ$. Therefore C is similar to A.
